statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail risk remains in the low band despite a record-high index and an elevated macro stress backdrop.
recommendation: Tail stays below the watch threshold on an orderly, low-volatility price path. The 13:30Z U.S. cash open is the narrow evidence-based checkpoint, where an aligned bullish regime could begin to deny retracement.
headline: Nasdaq-100 at record highs on narrow leadership; orderly path keeps Tail low while a 5.3% ten-year yield and a closed Strait of Hormuz hold Stress elevated.
body: NQ December futures trade at 31,428.50, up 0.35%, roughly 7 points below the 31,435.00 overnight high inside a narrow 126-point range. Cash NASDAQ-100 closed Monday at 31,076.44, up 0.87%, near the session high and at a record. VIX is 15.40, down 0.77%, in a 15.39-15.52 range. The macro backdrop is materially more stressed than the price path: the ten-year Treasury yield is near 5.31%, its highest since 2002, the thirty-year is above 5.6%, and the two-year was 4.83% in the latest H.15 release. Brent near $98.60 and WTI near $87.90 are both down 1.71% in a third consecutive decline as Middle East export flows recover, while the Strait of Hormuz remains closed pending Iran's seven stated conditions. September payrolls rose just 29,000 against an 84,000 consensus with July and August revised down a combined 60,000 and unemployment at 4.2 percent, yet the long end keeps rising on fiscal and energy-cost premia. Leadership is narrow and internally conflicting: Nvidia printed a record high and software outperformed, while the Philadelphia semiconductor index fell 0.3 percent, Intel dropped about 2 percent and the Dow closed lower. That conflict raises Stress and lowers directional conviction rather than amplifying Tail. The single genuine Tail amplifier is the index holding within a few points of its overnight high inside a record-high regime, which is the configuration that historically denies retracement into the New York open. Against it stand a compressed overnight range, VIX in the mid-fifteens, declining crude and no observed sequence of failed retracements or repeated extension. Tail is therefore held at 13 with a conditional lift into the 13:30Z opening auction.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock-hours carry published Claude assessments. Tail ran 14 at 10:00Z Monday, eased to 7 by 12:00Z, then climbed through the U.S. session to a 20 peak at 19:00Z as the index pushed to a record close, before decaying steadily overnight to 8-12 and printing 12 at 09:00Z. Stress stayed elevated throughout in a 45-55 band and Confidence held at 86-89. Mode alternated between mixed and trend-up, with a single trend-down reading at 10:00Z Monday.
outlookSummary: The orderly low-volatility path is expected to persist through the European morning, with Tail held in the low teens. Risk concentrates narrowly in the 13:30Z-15:00Z U.S. opening window, where the index enters the auction at record highs and Fed Williams and Bowman both speak; Tail is lifted conditionally to 18-19 there and again to 17 into the 20:00Z close. Thereafter conditional Tail decays to 11-13 across the Asian session before edging back up with the European open. All forecast hours remain below the watch threshold, so the mapped policy state stays EA_ON across the window. Stress holds in the mid-to-high forties throughout because the underlying mix of multi-decade-high long yields, near-$100 Brent and a closed Strait of Hormuz is unchanged by the hour of day. Confidence tapers from 87 to 80 with horizon decay. Scheduled catalysts beyond the window, notably the September FOMC minutes at 2026-10-07T18:00Z, are carried in the event calendar rather than the forecast.
